title: Extending Bioprocess Development with Nexxys
summary: Culture Biosciences quantifies the volumetric mass transfer coefficient of oxygen (ka) and specific power input (P/V) in bioreactors.
body_markdown:
This technical bulletin highlights how Nexxys™ extends bioprocess development capabilities through on-demand access to bioreactor capacity, experienced scientific expertise, integrated analytics, and cloud-connected experimentation. Featuring customer collaborations with MilliporeSigma and Thermo Fisher, the bulletin illustrates how Nexxys supports complex experimental programs and diverse bioprocess development needs. Drawing on more than 20,000 bioreactor runs across 100+ programs, 40+ species and organisms, and 1,600+ unique strains, Nexxys enables teams to expand experimental capacity, accelerate process optimization, and make more informed development decisions without additional equipment, staffing, or laboratory space.


[Download the Technical Bulletin](https://www.culturebiosciences.com/hubfs/09242026-Nexxys-White-Paper.pdf)
